hero.title: Role-based training that feels built for each person.
hero.subtitle: Create one course, then automatically adapt it for Sales, Ops, Support, Managers, or any job function, without rebuilding content.

definition.label: What is LearnPack
definition.line1: LearnPack is the AI platform that turns any document, video, or idea into interactive training in minutes, then adapts it by role with measurable learning analytics.
definition.line2: One source of truth. Multiple role paths. Real insight into who learned versus who clicked.

problem.title: One course cannot train five job realities.
problem.body: Most training is written for 'everyone' so it lands as 'no one.' Teams click through, managers cannot tell who is learning, and updates become expensive.

roleSwitcher.title: One course. Multiple role paths.
roleSwitcher.subtitle: Switch the role and watch the same module transform: examples, exercises, quizzes, and feedback.

sales.label: Sales
sales.challenge: Sales teams struggle to apply product knowledge in real conversations. Training is often theoretical, outdated, or disconnected from real objections and deal scenarios.
sales.adaptation:
The same product training course is reframed around sales conversations:
- Real objection-handling scenarios
- Discovery and qualification frameworks
- Practice focused on decision-making, not memorization
sales.outcome: Reps gain confidence faster, apply knowledge in live calls, and shorten ramp-up time without adding extra training programs.
sales.scenario: Handle pricing objections for a new product line
sales.quiz: Which question best reveals budget constraints?

support.label: Support
support.challenge: Support teams receive large amounts of documentation but lack structured guidance on how to troubleshoot issues under pressure.
support.adaptation:
LearnPack restructures the course around problem resolution:
- Incident-based learning paths
- Step-by-step diagnostic thinking
- Reinforcement of safe-first actions and escalation criteria
support.outcome: Faster issue resolution, fewer escalations, and more consistent support quality across the team.
support.practice: Build a decision tree from the knowledge base
support.quiz: What is the safest first diagnostic step?

operations.label: Operations
operations.challenge: Operational teams need consistency. Training often explains processes but fails to show how small deviations create bottlenecks and rework.
operations.adaptation:
The course is adapted to focus on workflows and execution:
- Visual process breakdowns
- Identification of failure points
- Decision-making at handoff moments
operations.outcome: More predictable execution, reduced operational errors, and smoother cross-team collaboration.
operations.scenario: Standardize a handoff process across locations
operations.practice: Map the workflow and flag failure points
operations.quiz: Which step reduces rework the most?

manager.label: Manager
manager.challenge: Managers are expected to reinforce training outcomes but are rarely trained on how to evaluate real learning versus completion.
manager.adaptation:
The course shifts from execution to evaluation:
- Coaching frameworks
- Skill assessment rubrics
- Signals that indicate applied learning, not just progress
manager.outcome: Managers can coach more effectively, identify gaps early, and ensure training translates into performance.
manager.practice: Use a rubric to evaluate applied skills
manager.quiz: Which metric signals real learning vs clicking?

newHire.label: New Hire
newHire.challenge: New hires are overwhelmed by information and often lack clarity on priorities during their first weeks.
newHire.adaptation:
The onboarding course is structured around guidance and progression:
- Clear first-week paths
- Guided checklists with milestones
- Context-aware support when learners get stuck
newHire.outcome: Faster onboarding, higher confidence, and earlier autonomy without increasing training workload
newHire.practice: Complete a guided checklist with milestones
newHire.quiz: What should you do if you get stuck mid-task?

separate.question: Is role-based training separate courses?
separate.answer: No. You maintain one baseline course and define role-specific adaptations. The AI Tutor and content automatically adjust based on the learner's role, while you keep a single source of truth for updates.

tutor.question: Does the AI Tutor change by role too?
tutor.answer: Yes. The AI Tutor (Rigobot) provides role-contextualized guidance. A Sales rep gets objection-handling hints while a Support agent gets diagnostic suggestions, all from the same underlying course.

export.question: Can we export role-based training to our LMS?
export.answer: Absolutely. Export as SCORM packages, embed via iFrame, or share unique URLs. Role assignments can be passed via launch parameters so your LMS controls who sees which adaptation.
